title: the sleep pass's checkpoint
description: <root>/sleep/state.json: each session store's size, in bytes, when the sleep pass last finished it, keyed <harness>/<session>.jsonl, so a pass that is stopped (a client connecting to the image) loses at most the store in hand and an unchanged store is skipped. Engine-private and rebuildable (docs/brain-memory.md, decision 12): deleting it only makes the next pass read every store again. Written by memory/cli/sleep.go (om sleep) and lisp/src/server/sleep.lisp (the image's idle child), under <root>/sleep/.lock.
